notes: Regression entry: python evals/run_evals.py (exit code = number of failing assertions, 0 = all pass).
Fixtures are generated by evals/build_fixtures.py; runs are repeatable and deterministic.
Every case writes artifacts to a temp directory only; the skill package stays read-only. Each case explicitly verifies that input file shas are unchanged (read-only, never modified).

evals.name: Golden path
evals.prompt: Use topic_template.xlsx and broker_template.xlsx from assets to expand replicas: replication factor 2, disk threshold 70%, run all three stages and produce the reassignment JSON.
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 status=PASS, all 22 partitions brought up to 2 replicas, no degradation, max disk usage 37.84%; Stage 2 merged table has 22 rows, no missing/duplicate, degradation column retained; Stage 3 emits JSON (version=1, 22 partition entries, len(replicas)=2, log_dirs[0]='any') with validation_fail=0.
expectations: Stage 1 status=PASS and exit code 0
Stage 1 partitions_total=22, new_replicas_assigned=22, degradation_count=0
Stage 1 max_disk_usage=37.84% (±0.5)
Stage 1 check 1.6 balance is PASS (new replicas not concentrated on a few brokers, max ≤ 4)
Stage 2 merged_rows=22, missing_partitions=0, duplicate_rows=0
Stage 2 merged table is 10 columns and retains the degradation column
Stage 3 status=PASS, total_entries=22, validation_fail=0
JSON version=1 and every partition has log_dirs[0]='any', len(replicas)=2
Input file shas unchanged (read-only)

evals.name: NO_OTHER_BROKER block (single-broker expansion)
evals.prompt: The cluster has only one broker (5 disks). Expand this topic from single-replica to double-replica, disk threshold 70%.
evals.expected_output: There is no distinct-broker placement; same-broker different-mount points are within threshold, but one partition's replicas must not contain duplicate broker IDs, so Kafka reassignment JSON cannot express this plan. Stage 1 must block: status=FAIL, exit code 2, no artifacts written, reason=NO_OTHER_BROKER, blockers give quantified gaps (0 distinct-broker mount points within threshold, N same-broker mount points unusable, add/expand a distinct-broker placement or free capacity).
expectations: Stage 1 exit code = 2 (not 0, not 1)
Stage 1 status=FAIL and reason=NO_OTHER_BROKER
Output directory empty (no half-finished artifacts on block)

blockers has at least 1 entry containing actionable info such as 'N replicas still needed', '0 distinct-broker mount points within threshold', 'cannot be expressed in Kafka reassignment JSON', 'raise --disk-threshold'
degradation_events explicitly states the stage stopped and wrote no artifacts
Input file shas unchanged

evals.name: L3 block (nothing usable within threshold)
evals.prompt: The only disk is already at 99%, still raise the factor to 2 with the threshold at 70%. Run if possible, otherwise tell me how much is missing.
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 must block: status=FAIL, exit code 2, no artifacts written, and blockers give quantified gaps (how many replicas of how many GB, 0 usable mount points, raise the threshold or add capacity).
expectations: Stage 1 exit code = 2 (not 0, not 1)
Stage 1 status=FAIL and reason=L3_BLOCKED
Output directory empty (no half-finished artifacts on block)
blockers has at least 1 entry containing actionable info such as 'N replicas still needed', '0 usable mount points', 'raise --disk-threshold'
degradation_events explicitly states the stage stopped and wrote no artifacts
Input file shas unchanged

evals.name: Read-only (input untouched + results reproducible)
evals.prompt: Compute the current allocation and show me, do not touch my original tables.
evals.expected_output: The whole pipeline only writes to the output directory; original topic/broker table shas stay unchanged; running twice with the same parameters yields identical results (stable sorting, not dependent on execution order).
expectations: Two runs produce identical Stage 1 stats (partitions_total, new_replicas_assigned, max_disk_usage, asset_partition_balance_max/min)
Two runs produce identical topic_new.xlsx content (xlsx bytes embed timestamps, compare content not sha)
No new files inside the skill package (no __pycache__, no runtime residue)
Input file shas unchanged after both runs

evals.name: Pre-existing over-threshold disk (warning not false-fail)
evals.prompt: One disk in the broker table is already at 90%; this table is exported from production, compute the expansion plan as usual.
evals.expected_output: A pre-existing over-threshold disk is not caused by this run: Stage 1 completes with PASS, never places new replicas on that disk, lists it in pre_existing_over_threshold; check 1.1 gives WARN advising to fix the disk first instead of failing the stage.
expectations: Stage 1 status=PASS and exit code 0
stats.pre_existing_over_threshold lists broker 1 /srv/BigData/data1 with its measured usage
Check 1.1 status is WARN (pre-existing issue does not fail the stage)
New replicas never land on an already over-threshold mount point
Input file shas unchanged

evals.name: Replication factor 3 + JSON split by N topics
evals.prompt: This time use factor 3; do not emit one big JSON, pack the JSON by 2 topics per file.
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 allocates to target factor 3; merged table columns expand with the factor and have no duplicate names; Stage 3 with topic_count=2 emits batch_1.json, batch_2.json, ..., each entry has replicas/log_dirs length 3.
expectations: Stage 1 status=PASS and new_replicas_assigned=44 (22 partitions × 2 new replicas each)
Stage 1 degradation_count=0 (enough distinct-broker placements)
Stage 2 merged table has 12 columns with no duplicate column names
Stage 3 every entry has replicas and log_dirs length 3
Stage 3 with topic_count strategy generates batch_N.json files and validation_fail=0

evals.name: Stage 3 hard check: duplicate brokers no longer exempt
evals.prompt: In this merged table both replicas of one partition land on broker 1 (marked degradation=L2). Can it be converted to JSON?
evals.expected_output: Must FAIL: Kafka reassignment JSON forbids duplicate broker IDs in one partition's replicas; rule 3.4 no longer grants the L2 exception, validation_fail>0, exit code 1, and the result no longer contains l2_exception_count (the pass-through concept is removed).
files: handcrafted topic_all.xlsx (constructed inside the case, not in fixtures)
expectations: Stage 3 exit code = 1 (not 0)
Stage 3 status=FAIL and stats.validation_fail > 0
Validation detail 3.4 status is FAIL (no PASS(L2-EXCEPTION) appears)
stats has no l2_exception_count / l2_exception_partitions

evals.name: Stage 3 topic-name path-traversal interception
evals.prompt: topic.xlsx has a topic name containing a path separator (../pwn); under per_topic it would be embedded into a file name. Can this be handled safely?
evals.expected_output: Must FAIL: topic names are untrusted input; before writing, the whitelist check (Kafka legal names [A-Za-z0-9._-], no . / .., max 249) and the realpath containment check run, reason=INVALID_TOPIC_NAME, exit code 1, no JSON file written, no file escapes outside the output directory; characters outside the whitelist (e.g. a Chinese topic name) are intercepted the same way.
files: handcrafted topic_all.xlsx (constructed inside the case, not in fixtures)
expectations: Stage 3 exit code = 1 and reason=INVALID_TOPIC_NAME
json directory empty (nothing written on block)
No file escapes outside the output directory (pwn.json does not exist)
Characters outside the whitelist (Chinese topic name) are intercepted the same way
